This AI-DLC checkout is a divergent documentation mirror: those five paths are absent locally and seven existing declared paths have different bytes, so it is not a source-bound review snapshot. Main-push runs 40702747511 and 40702746980 passed on the prior main tree, but do not attest the newly merged Bolt candidate. See verification/u1-pr51-story-merge-2026-10-28.md and verification/pr56-bootstrap-merge-2026-10-28.md. OK means the complete named criterion is demonstrated and targets implementation or test evidence in the committed Bolt; a validated C01-C27 candidate is not a C01 release or provider/runtime proof. GAP retains incomplete release, runtime, compatibility and downstream evidence obligations. R-14 through R-16, a matching source checkout, source-bound independent candidate review and U1 acceptance remain open.
